_doc: Manual labels for the 84 DECISION pick-misses of System 1 (R1 gen k=32 + R1 validator), keyed by train.json index. theme: grain = counting unit (COUNT vs COUNT DISTINCT / which key, join fan-out); ties = LIMIT 1 vs all tied rows; proj = which/how many output columns; sem = semantic constraint (missing/extra filter, wrong table or join route, literal, sort direction); aggcol = aggregate function or value column (COUNT(*) vs SUM(votes)); arith = arithmetic/ratio expression; notlive = right answer is empty/NULL so the live filter removes it; dq = SELECT DISTINCT + ORDER BY non-selected column + LIMIT (SQLite picks a different row); type = text vs integer. verdict: real = the right candidate is the better reading of question+evidence (a validator should prefer it); conv = both defensible, the BIRD gold convention decides; noise = the right candidate is semantically worse or matches by accident (gold quirk). Labelled by reading question, evidence, both SQLs and previews (2026-10-10, one annotator).
